The '''Xizor Transport Company headquarters''' was a building that [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]] were based and was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] oversaw the conglomerate operations from there.
